scope: Connect the existing DSR formula to complete saved parameter searches; a diagnostic, not a candidate gate or a substitute for the source-style trade-twin funnel.

policy.effective_trials: None resolves before queueing to powers of ten up to the raw search count plus that count. Custom1..16 distinct strict integers1..count; sorted canonically. These are assumptions, never estimated independence.
policy.dispersion_mode: empirical or assumed. Empirical sample SD of all finite per-session SRs across every evaluated configuration, including losses. At least two finite SRs required. Assumed requires an explicit finite nonnegative per-session SR SD. Empirical rejects an ignored supplied value.
policy.returns: Complete saved daily marked-equity percentage returns, zero risk-free assumption. Do not annualize inputs to the DSR formula. At least4 finite observations, positive sample return SD and finite bias-corrected skew/raw kurtosis. Preserve null/nonpositive-equity returns as undefined; never replace with zero.
policy.single_trial: N=1 uses zero rejection benchmark and needs no cross-trial dispersion; retain missing empirical dispersion explicitly.
policy.limits: No automatically inferred effective independent count. Scope is this search; undisclosed prior searches and serial dependence are not corrected. Zero dispersion is labeled as mechanically flat, not evidence against overfitting.
policy.report: Keep original account profit, sample/moment/dispersion counts, raw sampler counts, each configured assumption/score/undefined reason and original part hash. No pass/survived/profitable flag from DSR.
policy.durability: Freeze policy in original job payload before prices, include it in existing input/part/plan hashes; no root publication on summary failure. Cached recovery obeys existing authority.
